name: ConViS-Bench
description: ConViS-Bench is a vision benchmark hosted on Hugging Face designed to evaluate image models on curated tasks that emphasize robustness and generalization (e.g., distribution shifts, compositional changes). It provides standardized test splits and evaluation protocols to compare architectures and training strategies on supervised/robustness-focused image classification tasks. The benchmark emphasizes comparative evaluation of model robustness rather than raw in-distribution accuracy.
reputation: Small, community-hosted benchmark on Hugging Face; limited but growing use for robustness comparisons.
